programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly makes a shore lunch with her own version of cornflake-crusted fried fish with tartar sauce, saucy stove top bacon beans and a delicious strawberry rhubarb pretzel dessert.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh makes fun and tasty Pan-Asian fast foods with a homespun edge; Molly starts her snack day with a savory char siu sandwich and BEC fried rice before getting sweet with fish-shaped chocolate taiyaki and refreshing strawberry milk tea.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh throws an outdoor pizza party to celebrate her friends' second 40th birthdays; she makes cheesy baloney pizzas, a fun chicken parm Caesar salad, indulgent five spice limoncello and her moist matcha, red bean and almond rainbow cookie cake.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh makes a mighty Midwestern lunch to treat her oldest daughter! They bond over a cheesy Chicken Fajita Hotdish and gooey Monster Cookie Crispy Rice Treats. Then for dinner, it's hearty Chinese Black Bean Sloppy Joes and slurp-able Wild Rice Soup.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.sub_title: Beet Harvest Bake Off and Big Farm Lunch
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts a harvest bake-off for the farmers in the shop, submitting her own Chocolate Combine Cookies; she makes a big lunch with hearty Bacon Frittata Focaccia Sandwiches, Kimchi Mac and Cheese, and Broccolini and Cannellini Soup.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.sub_title: A Big, Bread-y, Buttery Family Feast
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts a big, bread-y, buttery family feast; she prepares Buttery Ham with a Spiced Honey Glaze, pillowy Parker House Rolls, Bacon Brussels Sprout Stuffing and Chocolate Coconut Silk Pie.
